questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Scientists see the evidence (1)/ of early life in (2)/ ancient rocks. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution: The sentence is entirely correct, both grammatically and contextually. Hence, Option 4) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Before you ﬁnalise (1)/ any of them, search (2)/ and comparing. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The error is in 3). While the entire sentence is in *simple present tense*, *comparing *isn't. Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.

*Before you finalise any of them, search and **compare**.*

questions.question:
**In**** the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct ****lternative**** out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.** 

Aashish tried to ______ smoking, but did not succeed.
questions.solution:
1) and 4) are ruled out since *get away *and *do away *require the presence of **with** after them. Option 3) *Give up (quit) *is the correct answer.

Note: *Put out = extinguish.* You put out a cigarette, not smoking.

Get away with (something) = go unnoticed; escape.

Do away with (something) = get rid of it.

questions.question:
**In**** the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.** 

Ashina has invited some of her friends ______ coffee.
questions.solution:
Coffee is the purpose **for **which she has invited her friends => Option 2) *For *is the correct answer.

You can't be **on** coffee. Nor can you be **to **coffee. You can go to some place **for **coffee, or drink coffee.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the give four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.** 

Amplify
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Boost"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Amplify **means to enlarge; to make bigger. Hence, Option 1) ***Boost ***is a synonym.

 
 
• Let us look at other words:
 
• **Boost** means help or encourages (something) to increase or improve.
 
• **Curtail **means to restrict.
 
• **Contract **means a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
 
• **Shorten **means make shorter than originally intended; reduce 
 
 

The correct word is **Boost**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.** 

Ill at ease

options.text: To be in a puzzling state

questions.solution: Ill at ease = uncomfortable; anxious; worried. Hence, Option 1) *To be worried *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.** 

Get the upper hand
questions.solution: To get an upper hand = to be in an advantageous position. Hence, Option 4) *To get an advantage *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.** 

Today is the (original day) to complete this, after it you won’t be able to do so.
questions.solution: If you can't do it **after **today => it's the **last day**. Hence, Option 1) *Last day *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.** 

(Attention) is better than cure.
questions.solution: Cure = to repair something that has gone bad or wrong. If we **prevent **something from going wrong, it won't need to be cured. Hence, Option 2) *Prevention *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.** 

Science of writing and compiling a dictionary
questions.solution:
Calligraphy = decorative handwriting or handwritten lettering.

Lexicography = the activity or occupation of compiling dictionaries.

Autobiography = an account of a person's life written by that person.

Bibliography = the history or systematic description of books, their authorship, printing, publication, editions, etc.

Hence, Option 2) *Lexicography *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.** 

Science of the constitution of the whole universe
questions.solution:
Cosmopolitan = familiar with and at ease in many different countries and cultures.

Chronicle = a factual written account of important or historical events in the order of their occurrence.

Cosmography = the branch of science which deals with the general features of the universe, including the earth.

Connoisseur = an expert judge in matters of taste.

Hence, Option 3) *Cosmography *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

Good books 

P: man in various 

Q: have always helped 

R: spheres of life
questions.solution:
*Good books *must be followed by a verb, which can only happen if Q is first in sequence => rule out 2) and 3). *Helping man *makes sense, *helping spheres *doesn't => P is second. Hence, Option 1) *QPR *is the correct answer.

*Good books have always helped man in various spheres of life.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

There is a 

P: in doing one’s work 

Q: honestly and efﬁciently 

R: sense of joy
questions.solution:
*There is a *must be followed by a noun, which can only be done if R is first in sequence => Option 3) *RPQ *is the correct answer.

There is a sense of joy in doing one's work honestly and efficiently.

questions.question: ___________ is everything
questions.solution:
• The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. 'Discipline'**
 
• The answer can be found in the very next sentence: *we all follow various types of **discipline***...

questions.question: It leads _______ on the right path.
questions.solution: The next sentence uses **we**. Since the entire para must be in the same tone => **us **will be used. Hence, Option 1) *Us *is the correct answer.

questions.question: types of discipline in our _______ lives.
questions.solution: Discipline is something that is to be followed regularly => *daily*. Hence, Option 2) *Daily *is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are many _______ like we wake
questions.solution: *Waking up early, drinking a glass of water etc. *are all **examples **of being disciplined => Option 4) *Examples *is the correct answer.

questions.question: have _______, go to school in uniform at right time, etc
questions.solution:
Morning is being talked about => Option 2) *Breakfast *is the correct answer.

__**Note:**__ Verb can be divided in to into two categories- 

__
 
• **Ordinary verb__: **to play, to sing, to write etc.
 
• **__Auxilliary verb__: **there are two types of auxiliary verbs.
 __
 
• **Primary auxiliary__: To be **(Is/am/are/was/were)**, to do **(do/does/did)**, to have **(has/have/had)
 
• **__Modal auxiliary__: **Can, could, may, might, will, would, should, etc.
 
 

So keep it in mind that the original form of **has/ have/had** is** to have, **that's why we have used **'****have breakfast'** not 'has breakfast'.
